records.title: metadata drift — barrel export counts diverge
records.remediation: Re-run Create Skill, which rebuilds `exports[]` and `stats.exports_public_api` in `skills/oms-uitripled/0.1.0/oms-uitripled/metadata.json` from the source. Update Skill does not repair this drift: each time it writes the skill it recounts `stats.exports_public_api` from the source and keeps `exports[]`, adding or dropping only the names its provenance map changes, so a metadata patch does not hold.
